facts.fact: Minister of Labour and Home Affairs Annah Mokgethi presented the National Registration Amendment Bill 2024 to amend the existing National Registration Act, which provides for the Omang identity card.

systems.owner: Ministry of Labour and Home Affairs

BWA.note: No enrolment count or share; only 641 cards uncollected at one office.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who operates or owns the system.
No register keyed on the ID stated.
Omang card mentioned; no unique number, biometrics or certification stated.
Nothing on local government office connection.
National registration is identity, not civil registration of births or deaths.
